name: x-mcp-ai
description: Safety-first X (Twitter) API v2 MCP server: 42 typed tools across 12 packages, policy-gated.
long_description:
Typed, policy-gated tools for the X (Twitter) API v2: posts, search, timelines, engagement, graph, lists, direct messages, media, archive and usage. A two-axis policy (read-only by default) decides which tools are offered, and a session spend budget caps pay-per-use cost.

OAuth 2.0 user context needs a one-time `npx -y x-mcp-ai authorize` in a terminal, with the same client ID and token file as here; app-only mode needs only a bearer token. Setup: https://github.com/IvanBBaev/x-mcp/blob/main/docs/10-operator-guide.md

x-mcp-ai is an independent, unofficial project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by X Corp.

auth_mode.title: Authentication mode
auth_mode.description: oauth2 (user context, the default) or app-only. Leave empty for the default.

client_id.title: OAuth 2.0 client ID
client_id.description: Client ID of your X app (oauth2 mode). Run `npx -y x-mcp-ai authorize` once with the same ID.

client_secret.title: OAuth 2.0 client secret
client_secret.description: Confidential clients only; PKCE public clients leave it empty.

token_file.title: Token file
token_file.description: Path of the OAuth 2.0 token store. Leave empty for the OS default (~/.config/x-mcp/tokens.json, %APPDATA%\x-mcp\tokens.json on Windows).

token_keychain.title: Use the OS keychain
token_keychain.description: 1 = keep OAuth 2.0 tokens in the OS keychain (macOS, Linux) instead of a token file. Leave empty or 0 for the file.

policy.title: Policy preset
policy.description: read-only (the default), engage, publish, manage or full.

policy_allow.title: Policy allow cells
policy_allow.description: Comma-separated op:domain cells allowed on top of the preset, e.g. read:dm,write:dm.

policy_deny.title: Policy deny cells
policy_deny.description: Comma-separated op:domain cells to deny; deny beats allow beats preset.

hide_denied.title: Hide denied tools
hide_denied.description: 1 = drop policy-denied tools entirely instead of listing them annotated as denied.

media_dir.title: Media directory
media_dir.description: Uploads must resolve inside this directory. Media upload stays disabled while it is empty.

availability.title: Special access classes
availability.description: Comma-separated specially provisioned classes: pilot, premium-user, enterprise. Empty = the conservative default.

profiles_file.title: Profiles file
profiles_file.description: Path to a profiles file holding named configuration blocks (multi-account).

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Name of the profile to select from the profiles file.

log_level.title: Log level
log_level.description: Diagnostics on stderr: silent, error, info (the default) or debug.

credit_budget.title: Session budget (USD)
credit_budget.description: Session spend cap in USD, e.g. 5.00. Empty = no cap.

budget_mode.title: Budget mode
budget_mode.description: warn (the default) or hard (calls past the cap fail with a budget error).

allow_proxy.title: Trust the env proxy
allow_proxy.description: 1 = trust a Node env-proxying HTTP(S) proxy and silence the startup warning.
